summary: All planned deletions are caller-free in src, tools and tests, untouched by the mutation manifest and hash-bound replay tests; verification_level can import verification without a cycle; REVIEW/V1 with medium impact is appropriate. Condition: the YAML replacement must keep a bounded content-keyed cache returning deepcopy (the cache was added in TASK-0056 for V2 deadline pressure) rather than plain yaml.safe_load measured on two modules.

findings.title: Keep a bounded content-keyed cache (<=64 entries, bypass >16384 chars) returning deepcopy on every call with uncached exceptions instead of plain yaml.safe_load
Dropping the dispatch guard allows stale cache results after runtime PyYAML mutation; delete changed-parser tests, keep semantic tests, document the limitation
Place the scenario runner at tests/e2e/scenario_runner.py; recheck coverage after it leaves the coverage source
V0_CHECK_IDS is a tuple; use required.issuperset(V0_CHECK_IDS)
Reduce the dual-mode mutation test to its synthetic branch; keep _validate_bindings coverage
Historical plan/state docs mentioning removed symbols stay unchanged (out of scope, not test-checked)
